description: Matched delayed-outcome credit experiment with owner-side residual training mode=ssl-rl-alternating. Both credit arms consume the same frozen-substrate rollouts; only the credit assignment unit differs. The causal rollout keeps the learned switch unit as beta owner; Internal RL supplies z candidates without replacing beta boundaries. Boundary, completion, reward, and outcome labels remain evaluation-only and never supervise beta. Train traces carry environment-demonstrated action vectors with provenance; eval and held-out rollouts receive observations but no action targets.
